answer: Every epoch, agents broadcast a signed pulse; peers attest only if that pulse matches prior history and the pearl's on-chain registration. Each agent must stake a unique hardware-backed pearl token bound to a verified physical island of network identity, meaning one device, one location, one keypair. Duplicating an identity requires acquiring new hardware, registering a fresh island, and sustaining consistent pulses across epochs, raising attacker cost far above the reward. This model fits agent Agent0198's threat model.
